2607.20558.title: StabilityBench: Benchmarking Instability in LLMs
2607.20558.paper_summary: AI Assistants are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings, such as healthcare or government services. Yet their real-world behavior remains poorly understood due to strong context dependence. Current evaluation protocols follow a defense-in-depth paradigm with compounding layers of safeguards, ranging from traditional benchmarks to live or adversarial testing. Such benchmarks remain largely static and single-turn, limiting their ability to capture real-world variability in conversational settings. We propose StabilityBench, a principled, general and model-agnostic benchmark operator that transforms single-turn benchmark queries into multi-turn interaction histories. StabilityBench augments existing benchmarks by injecting realistic user simulations, through demographic proxies or sycophantic baits, while preserving original task intent. We apply StabilityBench to four benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning, health question-answering and safety, and evaluate nine large language models under these conditions. Our results show that model performance is consistently unstable under these injections, with considerable performance degradations on three out of four benchmarks studied. These highlight important limitations of static evaluations and motivate more realistic evaluation settings. To this end, we propose StabilityBench-Mini: a size-preserving variant of StabilityBench that samples across diversification axes, enabling more realistic evaluation without increasing costs.
2607.20558.paper_summary_zh: AI 助手越來越多地應用於高風險環境，例如醫療或政府服務。<lb/>然而，由於強烈的上下文依賴，它們在現實世界中的行為仍然不甚了解。<lb/>目前的評估協議遵循深度防禦範式，具有多層次的保護措施，範圍從傳統基準到實時或對抗性測試。<lb/>這些基準在很大程度上仍然是靜態的且為單輪的，限制了它們捕捉對話環境中現實世界變異性的能力。<lb/>我們提出 StabilityBench，一個原則性、通用且與模型無關的基準運算符，將單輪基準查詢轉換為多輪互動歷史。<lb/>StabilityBench 通過注入現實的用戶模擬，使用人口統計代理或阿諛奉承的誘餌，來增強現有基準，同時保持原始任務意圖。<lb/>我們將 StabilityBench 應用於四個基準，涵蓋數學推理、健康問答和安全性，並在這些條件下評估九個大型語言模型。<lb/>我們的結果顯示，模型性能在這些注入下始終不穩定，在研究的四個基準中的三個上出現了顯著的性能下降。<lb/>這些結果突顯了靜態評估的重要局限性，並促使我們尋求更現實的評估環境。<lb/>為此，我們提出 StabilityBench-Mini：一個保持大小的 StabilityBench 變體，能夠在多樣化軸上進行抽樣，實現更現實的評估而不增加成本。
